blue-catfish: Anglers are catching a mix of striped bass, blue catfish, and flathead catfish.
Fishing for blue catfish in the Choptank River is good this week near the channel areas from the town of Choptank to Denton and up the Tuckahoe near the Route 328 bridge area.
bluefish: Anglers are enjoying excellent fishing for bluefish this week.
No doubt bluefish may be counted on to be in the mix.
Inside the inlet anglers are catching striped bass and a few bluefish by casting soft plastic jigs.
flathead-catfish: Anglers are catching a mix of striped bass, blue catfish, and flathead catfish.
largemouth-bass: Largemouth bass are shifting to a fall pattern of behavior and feeding this month.
In tidal water Chesapeake Channa will be part of the mix when fishing largemouth bass habitat.
northern-snakehead: Fishing for Chesapeake Channa, aka northern snakehead, in the tidal river grass flats remains good this week, and sunny afternoons may offer some of the best fishing opportunities.
smallmouth-bass: Fishing for smallmouth bass in the upper Potomac is being enjoyed by anglers this week.
Cooler water temperatures are more comfortable for smallmouth bass, and they are actively feeding on baitfish and crayfish.
Liberty and Prettyboy reservoirs are also providing good smallmouth bass fishing this week.
striped-bass: Upper Chesapeake Bay Frankie Goff fights a striped bass under the watchful eye of her dad.
Anglers are catching a mix of striped bass, blue catfish, and flathead catfish.
Fishing for striped bass in the shallower edges of the Susquehanna Flats, Bay shore and tidal river waters is a good option for anglers.
white-perch: Live-lining small white perch, eels, and spot along channel edges where striped bass can be spotted on depth finders is a good tactic.
White perch are still holding in the tidal creeks and middle sections of the region’s tidal rivers as long as water temperatures hold in the mid 60s.
Fishing with small minnows and grass shrimp near structure with good current flow is a good way to target the larger white perch.
